properties.description: Resets connectivity or disables one exact server vNIC/vHBA, including active/passive path actions. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations, compute.PhysicalSummaries, and selected host interfaces and PATCH the exact interface. OData names, exact organization/server/interface cardinality, concrete Blade/Rack source type, ownership, ancestor and AdapterUnit relationships, VethAction/VfcAction compatibility, and response identity are validated. The deterministic HostEthInterfaces/HostFcInterfaces filter uses Ancestors; OpenAPI does not prove every tenant populates the physical server there, so this route requires live-tenant validation. HTTP 200 proves accepted mutation only; completion polling is out of scope. Reset actions may be non-idempotent, so inspect the interface before retrying an ambiguous result.

properties.description: Validates exact user-facing values, rejects URL query delimiters, doubles apostrophes in all three OData names, limits actions to the documented VethAction/VfcAction intersection, and deterministically selects HostEthInterfaces or HostFcInterfaces.
properties.display_name: Validate inputs and direct interface route
properties.script:
import json
import sys

organizationRaw = sys.argv[1]
serverRaw = sys.argv[2]
interfaceTypeRaw = sys.argv[3]
interfaceRaw = sys.argv[4]
actionRaw = sys.argv[5]

organizationName = organizationRaw.strip()
serverName = serverRaw.strip()
interfaceType = interfaceTypeRaw.strip()
interfaceName = interfaceRaw.strip()
action = actionRaw.strip()
errors = []

if organizationRaw != organizationName or serverRaw != serverName or interfaceTypeRaw != interfaceType or interfaceRaw != interfaceName or actionRaw != action:
    errors.append("All inputs must use exact values without surrounding whitespace.")

def validate_odata_text(value, label, maximum):
    if not value or len(value) > maximum or any(ord(ch) < 32 or ch in "&?#%" for ch in value):
        errors.append(label + " must contain 1-" + str(maximum) + " characters and must not contain control or URL query-delimiter characters.")

validate_odata_text(organizationName, "Device Organization", 64)
validate_odata_text(serverName, "Server Name", 128)
validate_odata_text(interfaceName, "Interface Name", 128)

allowedTypes = {"vNIC", "vHBA"}
allowedActions = {"ResetConnectivity", "ResetConnectivityActive", "ResetConnectivityPassive", "Disable", "DisableActive", "DisablePassive"}
if interfaceType not in allowedTypes:
    errors.append("Interface Type must be exactly vNIC or vHBA.")
if action not in allowedActions:
    errors.append("Action is not one of the six supported reset or disable actions.")

escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'", "''")
escapedServerName = serverName.replace("'", "''")
escapedInterfaceName = interfaceName.replace("'", "''")
interfaceCollection = ""
expectedInterfaceObjectType = ""
actionField = ""
if interfaceType == "vNIC":
    interfaceCollection = "/api/v1/adapter/HostEthInterfaces"
    expectedInterfaceObjectType = "adapter.HostEthInterface"
    actionField = "VethAction"
elif interfaceType == "vHBA":
    interfaceCollection = "/api/v1/adapter/HostFcInterfaces"
    expectedInterfaceObjectType = "adapter.HostFcInterface"
    actionField = "VfcAction"

preparationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "ready"
preparationMessage = " ".join(errors) if errors else "Inputs, OData values, direct interface route, and exact action/type compatibility were validated."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({
    "validated": not errors,
    "errors": errors,
    "deviceOrganization": organizationName,
    "serverName": serverName,
    "interfaceType": interfaceType,
    "interfaceName": interfaceName,
    "action": action,
    "resolutionPath": "direct-interface-filter",
    "tenantFilterValidationRequired": True,
    "acceptedMutationOnly": True
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = preparationStatus in ("invalid", "ready") and bool(preparationMessage and preparationResultJson) and (preparationStatus != "ready" or bool(interfaceCollection and expectedInterfaceObjectType and actionField))

import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Organization response is missing a Results array")
organizationMoid = ""
if len(values) == 0:
    organizationStatus = "not-found"
    organizationMessage = "No exact organization matched Device Organization."
elif len(values) > 1:
    organizationStatus = "ambiguous"
    organizationMessage = "Multiple organizations matched Device Organization."
else:
    item = values[0]
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid):
        organizationStatus = "invalid"
        organizationMessage = "The organization response has an invalid exact name, discriminator, or URL-safe Moid."
    else:
        organizationStatus = "exact"
        organizationMoid = moid
        organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization identity was validated."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"status": organizationStatus, "message": organizationMessage, "organizationMoid": organizationMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = organizationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(organizationMessage and organizationResultJson)

properties.description: Requires exact cardinality and name, concrete vNIC/vHBA discriminators, URL-safe interface and adapter Moids, exactly one matching concrete server ancestor, exactly one organization permission relationship, and a valid AdapterUnit relationship.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
serverMoid = sys.argv[4]
sourceObjectType = sys.argv[5]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[6]
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Host interface response is missing a Results array")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

def relationship_matches(rel, moid, objectType):
    return isinstance(rel, dict) and rel.get("Moid") == moid and rel.get("ObjectType") == objectType and rel.get("ClassId") in (None, "mo.MoRef", objectType)

interfaceMoid = ""
adapterUnitMoid = ""
if len(values) == 0:
    interfaceStatus = "not-found"
    interfaceMessage = "No exact host interface matched name, physical-server ancestor, and organization permission."
elif len(values) > 1:
    interfaceStatus = "ambiguous"
    interfaceMessage = "Multiple host interfaces matched the exact direct lookup."
else:
    item = values[0]
    problems = []
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        problems.append("Host interface result is not an object.")
    else:
        moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "")
        ancestors = item.get("Ancestors")
        permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
        serverMatches = [r for r in ancestors if relationship_matches(r, serverMoid, sourceObjectType)] if isinstance(ancestors, list) else []
        orgMatches = [r for r in permissions if relationship_matches(r, organizationMoid, "organization.Organization")] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
        adapter = item.get("AdapterUnit")
        adapterMoid = str(adapter.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(adapter, dict) else ""
        adapterMatches = [r for r in ancestors if relationship_matches(r, adapterMoid, "adapter.Unit")] if isinstance(ancestors, list) and adapterMoid else []
        if not safe_moid(moid):
            problems.append("Host interface Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if item.get("Name") != expectedName:
            problems.append("Host interface Name does not exactly match Interface Name.")
        if item.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or item.get("ClassId") != expectedObjectType:
            problems.append("Host interface discriminators do not match Interface Type.")
        if len(serverMatches) != 1:
            problems.append("Ancestors must contain exactly one matching concrete physical-server relationship.")
        if len(orgMatches) != 1:
            problems.append("PermissionResources must contain exactly one matching organization relationship.")
        if not isinstance(adapter, dict) or not safe_moid(adapterMoid) or adapter.get("ObjectType") != "adapter.Unit" or adapter.get("ClassId") not in (None, "mo.MoRef", "adapter.Unit"):
            problems.append("AdapterUnit must be a valid adapter.Unit relationship.")
        if len(adapterMatches) != 1:
            problems.append("Ancestors must contain exactly one relationship matching AdapterUnit.")
    if problems:
        interfaceStatus = "invalid"
        interfaceMessage = " ".join(problems)
    else:
        interfaceStatus = "exact"
        interfaceMoid = item["Moid"]
        adapterUnitMoid = adapterMoid
        interfaceMessage = "Exactly one interface and all server, organization, and adapter relationships were validated."
interfaceResultJson = json.dumps({"status": interfaceStatus, "message": interfaceMessage, "interfaceMoid": interfaceMoid or None, "interfaceObjectType": expectedObjectType, "adapterUnitMoid": adapterUnitMoid or None, "resolutionPath": "direct-interface-filter", "tenantFilterValidationRequired": True}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = interfaceStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(interfaceMessage and interfaceResultJson) and (interfaceStatus != "exact" or bool(interfaceMoid and adapterUnitMoid))

properties.description: Builds one type-compatible mutation, submits it once, validates the returned interface identity, and reports accepted-only semantics.
Revalidates action/type compatibility and builds one concrete HostEthInterface/VethAction or HostFcInterface/VfcAction PATCH body with exact root discriminators.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
interfaceType = sys.argv[1]
action = sys.argv[2]
actionField = sys.argv[3]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
interfaceMoid = sys.argv[5]
serverResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
interfaceResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[7])
allowedActions = {"ResetConnectivity", "ResetConnectivityActive", "ResetConnectivityPassive", "Disable", "DisableActive", "DisablePassive"}
if interfaceType == "vNIC":
    requiredType = "adapter.HostEthInterface"
    requiredField = "VethAction"
    collection = "/api/v1/adapter/HostEthInterfaces/"
elif interfaceType == "vHBA":
    requiredType = "adapter.HostFcInterface"
    requiredField = "VfcAction"
    collection = "/api/v1/adapter/HostFcInterfaces/"
else:
    raise ValueError("Interface Type has no mutation route")
if action not in allowedActions or actionField != requiredField or expectedObjectType != requiredType:
    raise ValueError("Action and interface type/field compatibility are invalid")

request = {"ClassId": requiredType, "ObjectType": requiredType, requiredField: action}
mutationUrl = collection + interfaceMoid
mutationBodyJson = json.dumps(request, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = bool(mutationUrl and mutationBodyJson and requiredType and requiredField)

properties.script:
import json
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
statusCode = int(sys.argv[2])
interfaceMoid = sys.argv[3]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
actionField = sys.argv[5]
action = sys.argv[6]
interfaceType = sys.argv[7]
serverResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[8])
interfaceResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[9])
if statusCode != 200:
    raise ValueError("Interface mutation response must use documented HTTP 200")
if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    raise ValueError("Interface mutation response must be an object")
if payload.get("Moid") != interfaceMoid:
    raise ValueError("Interface mutation response Moid does not match the exact interface")
if payload.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or payload.get("ClassId") not in (None, expectedObjectType):
    raise ValueError("Interface mutation response discriminators do not match Interface Type")
if payload.get(actionField) != action:
    raise ValueError("Interface mutation response does not echo the exact requested action field and value")
acceptanceMessage = "Server interface connectivity mutation was accepted; connectivity completion was not polled or verified."
acceptedResultJson = json.dumps({
    "requestAccepted": True,
    "completed": False,
    "completionVerified": False,
    "httpStatus": statusCode,
    "interfaceType": interfaceType,
    "action": action,
    "serverResolution": serverResolution,
    "interfaceResolution": interfaceResolution,
    "response": payload,
    "resolutionPath": "direct-interface-filter",
    "tenantFilterValidationRequired": True,
    "note": acceptanceMessage,
    "retryWarning": "Reset actions may be non-idempotent. Inspect the interface before retrying after any ambiguous outcome."
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = bool(acceptanceMessage and acceptedResultJson)
